mapper.select: select sum(refund_price) as price from eb_user_recharge where refund_price > 0 and paid = 1

select ur.*,u.nickname,u.avatar from eb_user_recharge as ur left join eb_user as u on ur.uid = u.uid where ur.paid = 1
and ur.order_no like CONCAT('%',#{orderNo},'%')
and ur.create_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
and ( ur.uid like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or u.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or u.phone like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') )
and ur.uid = #{uid}
and u.nickname like CONCAT('%',#{nickname},'%')
and u.phone like CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%')
order by ur.id desc
